verdict.rationale: Buzz is designed so agents do through the relay protocol and CLI what humans do in the app: open repos, send patches, review, run workflows, edit canvases, create channels and join huddles. The CLI and its packaged skill cover messaging, channels, DMs, workflows, feed, reactions, canvas, repos, uploads and memory, and third-party Nostr clients connect directly to the relay, with an admin API alongside. Missing for 10: an explicit documented parity guarantee or API reference (all OpenAPI probes returned 404), complete feature coverage over the Nostr wire protocol (the docs show a partial feature-status table), fully headless agent creation (drafts need owner review in the Desktop app), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
